correctness.rationale: The three distinct arm-path eigenvalues each lift to an (m−1)-dimensional independent eigenspace via coefficient sum zero. Their cubic annihilating polynomial has nullity at least 3(m−1). On the ordinary graph cube its entries at distances 3, 2, and 1 are respectively 1, −s1, and deg(u)+deg(v)−1+s2. For arm length >=5 all three roots are nonnegative and s1>0, s2>=0; at length 4 explicit golden-ratio values give s1>0 and s2>−2. This proves exact off-diagonal support. The usual maximum-nullity <= zero-forcing inequality then yields the lower bound. A fully specified forcing schedule starting with the outermost three vertices of m−1 arms achieves the upper bound. Forty finite matrix/seed checks and eight brute checks support but do not replace the all-parameter proof.
